_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley SimpleNonVillagerDialogues.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

derby_contestent0.japanese: 釣り人：このためにわざわざグランプルトンから来たんだ。||釣り人：バッグいっぱいのマスを持たずに帰るわけにはいかない！
derby_contestent0.english: Fisherman: I came all the way from Grampleton for this.||Fisherman: I'm not going home without a bag full of trout!

segments.kana: わけ に は いかない

derby_contestent1.japanese: 船乗り：このイベントにこの服はちょっと大げさかな？
derby_contestent1.english: Mariner: Am I a bit overdressed for this event?

derby_contestent2.japanese: 船乗り：きっと私と同じ服装の人も来るだろうけどね。恥ずかしい人たちだ！
derby_contestent2.english: Mariner: Of course someone turns up in the same outfit as me. How embarrassing!

derby_contestent3.japanese: 釣り人：すまないが、私は静かに過ごしたいんだ。||Fisherman： …||Fisherman： …||Fisherman： …||Fisherman：なにかコツを教えてくれないか？||Fisherman： …||Fisherman： …||Fisherman： …||Fisherman：そろそろ我慢の限界だけど、それはマスに対してじゃない。||Fisherman： …
derby_contestent3.english: Fisherman: Excuse me, I'm trying to enjoy the quiet.||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: Could you give me a tip?||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: I'm nearly at the end of my patience, and it isn't with the trout.||Fisherman: ...

derby_contestent4.japanese: 釣り姉妹：||私たちはちょっと名の知れた釣り姉妹なのよ！釣り姉妹：釣りたいと思っただけ魚が釣れるの！私たちには構わないで！
derby_contestent4.english: Fishing sisters:||We're the somewhat famous fishing sisters! Fishing sisters: We'll catch as many fish as we wish! Don't mind us!

derby_contestent5.japanese: 釣り師：釣りの調子？魚には相手にされずに、蚊に刺されてばかりだよ…
derby_contestent5.english: Angler: How's the fishing? The fish ignore me and the mosquitoes keep biting...

derby_contestent6.japanese: トラウトマン：私は周りから「トラウトマン」と呼ばれているんだ。||トラウトマン：私は5年間、マスになったつもりで生活しているんだ。食べる、食べる、食べる、タマゴを産む、また食べる。||トラウトマン：食べるのは得意なんだ。タマゴを産むのはうまくいかないけどね。
derby_contestent6.english: Trout Man: People around here call me "Trout Man".||Trout Man: For five years I've lived as though I were a trout. Eat, eat, eat, lay eggs, eat again.||Trout Man: I'm good at the eating. The egg-laying doesn't go so well.

derby_contestent7.japanese: 釣り人：人込みから離れたいって？私も同じ気持ちだよ。
derby_contestent7.english: Fisherman: Trying to get away from the crowds? I feel the same.

derby_contestent8.japanese: 釣りのプロ：これは競争ではないが… タグを一番多く手に入れたら、一年間自慢して暮らせるんだ！||釣りのプロ：冬になったらイカ釣りまつりにも来るよ…あれは真の挑戦だ！||釣りのプロ：マスを釣る秘訣は、エサをおいしく見せるテクニックを身につけて、マスが思わず食いつくようにすることだよ…
derby_contestent8.english: Fishing Pro: It isn't a competition, but... whoever gets the most tags gets a year of bragging rights!||Fishing Pro: I'll come back for SquidFest in winter... now that's a real challenge!||Fishing Pro: The secret to catching trout is mastering the technique of making your bait look so delicious the trout can't help but bite...

derby_contestent9.japanese: 釣り人：ああ、これこそが人生だよ。マス釣りよりも落ち着けるものは他にないね。
derby_contestent9.english: Fisherman: Ah, this is the life. Nothing is more peaceful than trout fishing.

winter_derby_contestent0.japanese: 釣り人：イカはたいてい夜にしか姿を見せない。しかし、今日は特別なエサがまかれているから一日中イカが釣れるんだ。
winter_derby_contestent0.english: Fisherman: Squid usually only show at night. But today they've put special bait in the water, so you can catch them all day.

winter_derby_contestent1.japanese: 船乗り：冷えた空気は私の体をジャーキーのように引きしめてくれる。||船乗り：暖かすぎる空気は私の体をプリンのようにしてしまう。
winter_derby_contestent1.english: Mariner: The cold air firms me up like jerky.||Mariner: Air that's too warm turns me into a pudding.

winter_derby_contestent10.japanese: 釣り人：手が凍えそうだから、こっちでホットサイダーを飲んでるんだ。幸運を！
winter_derby_contestent10.english: Fisherman: My fingers are freezing, so I'm over here with a hot cider. Good luck!

winter_derby_contestent11.japanese: イカの料理人：ああ、私のことは気にしないで…イカの値段を見に来たんだ。||イカの料理人：ここで何をしているんだい？イカは向こうからはやってこないよ！
winter_derby_contestent11.english: Squid chef: Oh, don't mind me... I've come to see the price of squid.||Squid chef: What are you doing here? The squid won't come to you!

winter_derby_contestent2.japanese: 船乗り：おいでおいで、イカちゃん…

winter_derby_contestent3.japanese: 釣り人：地元の人かい？きみのイカを少しわけてもらえないかな…
winter_derby_contestent3.english: Fisherman: You're a local, then? Mind if I take a few of your squid...

winter_derby_contestent4.japanese: 釣り姉妹：私たちはちょっと名の知れた釣り姉妹なのよ。||釣り姉妹：小さなころからイカを釣ってきたわ。私たちには構わないで！
winter_derby_contestent4.english: Fishing sisters: We're the somewhat famous fishing sisters.||Fishing sisters: We've been catching squid since we were small. Don't mind us!

winter_derby_contestent5.japanese: 釣り師：（ブルブル）…寒い！私は冬の海釣りには向いていないのかもしれない。||釣り師：コイ釣りまつりもあればいのに…
winter_derby_contestent5.english: Angler: *Shiver*... it's cold! Maybe I'm not cut out for winter sea fishing.||Angler: I wish there were a CarpFest too...

winter_derby_contestent6.japanese: トラウトマン：イカはマスとは違うけど、同じように釣れるよ。||トラウトマン：賞品をねらっているなら、釣りに行った方がいいよ！
winter_derby_contestent6.english: Trout Man: Squid are different from trout, but I catch them just the same.||Trout Man: If you're after the prize, you'd better get fishing!

winter_derby_contestent7.japanese: 釣り人：出かけるときに妻が保温ポットに熱いコーヒーを入れてくれたんだ。最高の女性だよ！
winter_derby_contestent7.english: Fisherman: My wife filled a flask with hot coffee when I set off. What a woman!

winter_derby_contestent8.japanese: 釣りのプロ：しーっ…イカを刺激したくないんだ。||釣りのプロ：人込みから離れたくってこっちに来たんだ。イカには引っ込み思案なところがあるからね。||釣りのプロ：お望みならここで釣ってもいいよ。でも静かにね。
winter_derby_contestent8.english: Fishing Pro: Shh... I don't want to startle the squid.||Fishing Pro: I came over here to get away from the crowd. Squid can be shy.||Fishing Pro: You can fish here if you like. Just be quiet.

winter_derby_contestent9.japanese: 釣り人：勝ち負けはあまり気にしてないよ。雰囲気を楽しめればそれでいいんだ。||釣り人：夏もいいけど、冬のきびしい寒さも好きなんだ。人生にだって対照的なことはたくさんあるだろう？
winter_derby_contestent9.english: Fisherman: I'm not much bothered about winning. Enjoying the atmosphere is enough.||Fisherman: Summer is fine, but I like the harsh cold of winter too. Life is full of contrasts, isn't it?
